assertions.subject: Gram-negative bacillary infection
assertions.quote: Mortality rate for gram-negative neonatal bacterial meningitis is 15 to 20%

assertions.subject: Gram-negative bacillary infection
assertions.quote: Neurologic sequelae (eg, hydrocephalus, hearing loss, intellectual disability) develop in 20 to 50% of infants who survive

assertions.subject: Gram-negative bacillary infection
assertions.quote: Those from gram-negative bacillary meningitis remain positive longer, with a median of 2 days

assertions.subject: Gram-negative bacillary meningitis
assertions.quote: A 3rd-generation cephalosporin (eg, cefotaxime) should be strongly considered in neonates with proven gram-negative meningitis (or sepsis) or those convincingly septic

assertions.subject: Gram-negative bacillary infection
assertions.quote: For organisms that cause vasculitis or brain abscess (necrotizing meningitis), the mortality rate may approach 75%
